title: Ogre: GEV second movement, overrun, win conditions
description: GEV second movement phase after combat. Overrun: Ogre entering a hex with defenders forces overrun combat (Ogre AP guns vs each unit at 1:1). Win conditions: Ogre wins by destroying Command Post. Defender wins by immobilizing Ogre (treads=0 AND all weapons destroyed). Draw if Ogre immobilized but CP destroyed.
close_reason: GEV second movement, overrun combat (AP guns vs defenders), win conditions (CP destroyed/Ogre neutralized). 10 tests.
